fusions.name: Pouncing Drop
fusions.desc: A leaping blow that deals 7 damage, up to 2 times as much at 6 tiles. Holds 4 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Heavy Landing
fusions.desc: Leaps clear and comes down on the spot, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Leapfrog Guard
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away and raises your dodge chance by 15% for the moment you land.

fusions.name: Spring-Loaded Mail
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
